reports.title: Blue River PFHA fishing report
reports.text: Largemouth Bass, Smallmouth Bass, Spotted Bass Good on grubs, lipless baits, small lures, topwater lures, tube jigs around brush structure, channels, shallows, weed beds.

reports.title: Kaw Lake fishing report
reports.text: Black Crappie, White Crappie Good on hair jigs, jigs, minnows, tube jigs around brush structure, riprap.

reports.title: Grand Lake fishing report
reports.text:
Largemouth Bass Fair on crankbaits, plastic baits, spinnerbaits around brush structure, docks, shorelines.
White Crappie Fair on jigs, minnows around brush structure, docks.

reports.title: Konawa fishing report
reports.text: Largemouth Bass Good on crankbaits, plastic baits around main lake, points, river channel, weed beds.

reports.title: Keystone Lake fishing report
reports.text:
Black Crappie, White Crappie Fair on jigs, minnows around brush structure, main lake.
Largemouth Bass Good on crankbaits, in-line spinnerbaits, jerk baits, jigs, plastic baits around brush structure, main lake.

reports.title: Spavinaw Lake fishing report
reports.text:
Largemouth Bass, Smallmouth Bass Fair on crankbaits, jigs around main lake, points.
Black Crappie, White Crappie Fair on jigs, minnows around brush structure, docks.

reports.title: McGee Creek fishing report
reports.text:
Largemouth Bass, Spotted Bass Good on bill baits, in-line spinnerbaits, jerk baits, jigs, minnows, spinnerbaits, other around brush structure, riprap, rocks, standing timber.
Black Crappie, White Crappie Good on minnows, small lures, tube jigs around brush structure, main lake, standing timber.

reports.title: Texoma fishing report
reports.text:
Black Crappie, White Crappie Fair on caddis flies, hair jigs, jigs, minnows, PowerBait around brush structure, coves, points, standing timber.
Crappie are biting around brush piles on points and in docks with brush with jigs.

reports.title: Broken Bow Lake fishing report
reports.text:
Largemouth Bass, Spotted Bass Good on Alabama rig, crawfish, spinnerbaits, worms around coves, creek channels, points.
Black Crappie, White Crappie Good on jigs around brush structure, standing timber.

reports.title: Hugo Lake fishing report
reports.text:
Largemouth Bass, Spotted Bass, White Bass Slow on jigs, plastic baits around points, river channel, standing timber.
Black Crappie, White Crappie Slow on jigs, minnows, small lures around brush structure, standing timber.

reports.title: Pine Creek Lake fishing report
reports.text:
Largemouth Bass Slow on crankbaits, jerk baits around coves, points.
White Crappie Slow on jigs, minnows around brush structure, main lake, standing timber.

reports.title: Sardis Lake fishing report
reports.text:
Largemouth Bass Good on bill baits, crankbaits, lipless baits, plastic baits, spinnerbaits around brush structure, shorelines, standing timber, weed beds.
Black Crappie, White Crappie Good on jigs, minnows around brush structure, standing timber.

reports.title: Wister Lake fishing report
reports.text:
Largemouth Bass Good on buzz baits, spinnerbaits around brush structure.
White Crappie Good on jigs, minnows around brush structure.
reports.by: James Williams (Game Warden Le Flore County)
